com.wac.autocore.data

Class Migrations

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.wac.autocore.data.Migrations

  • final class Migrations
extends java.lang.Object
    The schema's history. One file per change, run in order, and a register of which ones have run. The register is what makes a second start cost nothing. In a file, every statement ends with a semicolon and lines starting with -- are comments.

      • FILES

        private static final java.lang.String[] FILES
        In order. A new change gets the next number and is added last.

      • ADDED_COLUMNS

        private static final java.lang.String[][] ADDED_COLUMNS
        The columns the baseline expects and a database from an earlier sprint does not have. The baseline's CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS leaves a table it finds alone, so those columns are added here, and only the ones that are missing. The same columns stand in 001_baslinjen.sql — a column added there belongs here too, and the L3 proof fails if the two drift apart.
